tools.name: get_nyc_zip_market_snapshot
tools.description: Get sale price quartiles, median price per square foot, sample size, and trend for an exact NYC ZIP.

tools.name: compare_nyc_price_per_square_foot
tools.description: Calculate a property's price per square foot and compare it with its exact NYC ZIP's recorded-sale median.

tools.name: list_nyc_market_momentum
tools.description: List the top published NYC ZIPs by recorded-price momentum, transaction velocity, liquidity, and comp depth.

tools.name: list_published_datasets
tools.description: Discover published nationwide market data, Florida recorded sales, and the NYC property, sale and comparable data. Includes coverage, provenance and available operations.

tools.name: search_housing_markets
tools.description: Search the published 50-state and DC dataset by state, county, Census place, or ZIP. Filter or sort on asking price or Census owner-reported value. Use a geography level to enumerate its records.

tools.name: get_housing_market
tools.description: Get national or exact state, county, or ZIP pricing, housing stock, and available FHFA trend data. No broader substitute is returned.

tools.name: list_florida_counties
tools.description: List the active release, property counts and latest recorded-sale month for all 67 Florida counties.

tools.name: get_florida_sales_profile
tools.description: Get statewide or county sale price quartiles, property-type and month breakdowns, and the published county ZIP and city breakdowns. Price statistics require at least 10 records.

tools.name: search_florida_recorded_sales
tools.description: Read an exact county's published residential sales. Filter by postal ZIP, city, address, property type, or month. Follow the next cursor with the same filters. Dates have month precision.

tools.name: search_nyc_properties
tools.description: Browse verified property or residential condo unit identities. Filter by exact NYC ZIP or an address fragment. Property prices are labeled separately from condo sales.

tools.name: get_nyc_property
tools.description: Resolve a verified published NYC property ID, condo unit BBL, or condo unit page slug.

tools.name: list_nyc_recorded_sales
tools.description: Read verified recorded sales for an exact NYC ZIP, published property ID, condo unit BBL, or building BBL. Provide exactly one location selector. Dates have day precision.

tools.name: get_nyc_property_comps
tools.description: Read the current published comparable sale set for a verified NYC property or condo unit. Scores and adjusted amounts describe the comparable model.

tools.name: get_nyc_market_aggregates
tools.description: Read the active NYC market publication by exact ZIP or published geography ID, including date, sample count, price and trend. State statistics summarize published NYC ZIP benchmarks.
